About the Portal

The Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal enables browsing, searching, and analysis of human genetic and genomic information linked to musculoskeletal traits and diseases, while protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the underlying data.

The MSK-KP is being developed in collaboration with the International Federation of Musculoskeletal Research Societies

View complementary resources for musculoskeletal research at the IFMRS Learning Environment Hub

About the project

The Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal (MSK-KP) is being developed by a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute in collaboration with the International Federation of Musculoskeletal Research Societies (IFMRS).

We welcome the involvement of interested researchers. Contact us to learn more about contributing data or collaborating with us on analyses, methods, or tool development.

Getting started

Are you interested in what human genetics can tell you about your favorite gene, but not sure where to start in the MSK-KP? We've outlined a workflow that can help you assess the weight of genetic evidence for involvement of a gene in a biological process. See the workflow in a step-by-step guide or in this brief video.
